The attacks were inspired by the Islamic State group and are among the deadliest in the country's history.

The ruling delivers convictions in one of Sri Lanka’s deadliest attacks, but does not resolve separate questions about security failures or the full scope of responsibility.

He emphasized the need for an overhaul of UN institutions to better address global challenges and called for a collaborative approach among superpowers. Guterres also condemned violence in Gaza and the expansion of settlements in the West Bank.
